responsibility: Defines the RTL operand predicates used by Blackfin instruction patterns to recognize legal constants, registers, memory forms, symbolic references, comparison operators, and multi-register push/pop structures. These predicates encode target-specific legality tests such as D/P/loop-register classes, 16-bit load/store address forms, eliminable-register exclusions, and immediate classes that are more semantic than raw constraints, and are consumed directly by bfin.md pattern matching and expansion.
